adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces async pagination/actions that call `group.findMembers()` without any request sequencing or cancellation. In `admin-group.js.es6`, `next`/`previous` update `group.offset` and immediately `return group.findMembers()`. `findMembers()` performs `Discourse.ajax(...)` and in `.then(...)` unconditionally `setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members: ... })` from the response. If multiple requests are in-flight (e.g., clicking next twice quickly, or a pagination request overlapping with the `addMembers`/`removeMember` reload which also calls `self.findMembers()`), a slower older response can arrive last and overwrite `members/offset` with stale data, reverting the UI to an earlier page. The diff shows no token/sequence guard to prevent this.
